text:
alex_sales: FYI ACME POC hit a wall — SCIM user provisioning failing with 409 on POST /scim/v2/Users. SSO (SAML) login works but users aren't getting created. Can we triage?

ryan_eng: Do we have the raw SCIM request/response? 409 usually means "user already exists" or uniqueness constraint mismatch. Short logs please.

alex_sales: Pasting reduced logs from their side: ```HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict
Content-Type: application/json
{
  \"detail\": \"User with externalId already exists\",
  \"status\": 409
}``` They say Okta is set to create users on first SAML login and also provision via SCIM.

maya_security: double check attribute mapping between IdP and our SCIM. We expect `externalId` to be set to the IdP user id (okta user id) or `userName` to be the same stable identifier. If both systems try to create the same user with different fields it can conflict.

priya_oncall: Also check whether they used POST vs PUT for provisioning. Some IdPs POST on create and PATCH for updates; our SCIM endpoint treats duplicate `userName` or `externalId` as conflict. Ask ACME to share the SCIM payload (redact emails).

alex_sales: ACME sent this sample payload from Okta: ```{
  \"schemas\": [\"urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User\"],
  \"userName\": \"j.doe@example.com\",
  \"externalId\": \"00u1abcdXYZ\",
  \"name\": {\"givenName\": \"John\", \"familyName\": \"Doe\"},
  \"active\": true
}``` Response was 409 with message above.

ryan_eng: OK that payload looks fine. Two quick possibilities: 1) There's an existing user with the same email in the tenant (maybe created manually earlier) but externalId differs. Our unique constraint is on (tenant_id, normalized_userName) and externalId uniqueness is optional depending on config. 2) If they attempted a previous create that partially succeeded (DB row without externalId) the second create can hit a constraint.

sam_se: Did they use Hosted API keys for the POC or are they hitting Dedicated pool endpoints (VPC)? SCIM for Private deployments routes differently and the tenant partitioning can cause confusion. Alex: which?

alex_sales: They're on the hosted POC keys we spun up from the portal (tagged `poc-acme-2026`). No Dedicated or VPC yet.

maya_security: If they later request Private/VPC provisioning we need to ensure SCIM base URL matches the private ingress. For now, focus on hosted. Two practical fixes: 1) Ask them to run a GET /scim/v2/Users?filter=userName eq "j.doe@example.com" to see existing entry. 2) If a duplicate exists, have them PATCH that user to add `externalId` instead of POSTing.

priya_oncall: Quick curl they can run: ```curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>" "https://api.redwood-inference.com/tenants/acme/scim/v2/Users?filter=userName eq \"j.doe@example.com\""``` Replace <POC_KEY>.

alex_sales: I'll send that to ACME. They also flagged SAML attribute mapping — their IdP is sending `eduPersonPrincipalName` for the nameid instead of `userPrincipalName`/email. Could that break provisioning?

ryan_eng: SAML login can succeed with any NameID format if the SAML mapping maps it to our `userName` attribute. But SCIM provisioning and automatic create-on-login rely on consistent identifier. If the NameID and SCIM `userName` don't match, you'll get duplicates or conflicts. We should confirm the SAML assertion contains an attribute that maps to `userName` (email) or set Okta to send `user.userprincipalname` as an attribute.

sam_se: For Okta: Settings we usually advise: set `userName` to `user.email` or `user.login`, enable SCIM provisioning to send `externalId = user.id`, and set update mode to "Sync only on create/update" to avoid race conditions.

alex_sales: ACME also asked about Dedicated pool access during POC — they want to test throughput and provisioning at scale. Do we have a short-term Dedicated trial policy or special pricing?

maya_security: Pricing ops note: we can offer a 30-day Dedicated eval with a reduced commit; need approval from sales_ops. Not automatic. 

priya_oncall: From ops side, if they test Dedicated we need to provision a tenant in the dedicated cluster (manual step). That will also change SCIM endpoint URL and SAML ACS. So we should confirm their SSO metadata **before** migrating.

ryan_eng: Action items: 1) Alex -> ask ACME to run the GET filter curl and paste response. 2) If user exists, either PATCH to add `externalId` or delete stale record then POST. 3) If they plan Dedicated trial, request a migration window so we can update ACS and metadata and avoid dual writes.

alex_sales: I'll send the steps and request logs. I'll also ask whether they can try PATCH first. I'll loop back with response.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Notified: Created ticket INF-POC-4235 to track ACME SCIM provisioning issue.

sam_se: If ACME wants help, I can join the call tomorrow to walk through Okta mapping and run test provisioning. ping me if you schedule.

alex_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll update thread after ACME runs the GET. :thumbsup:

ryan_eng: If they paste the GET result and we still see 409, include the full response headers (server request-id) and I'll escalate to DB logs.

alex_sales: Will do — thanks.
